laptopGPU.title: GeForce RTX 50 Series laptop specifications
laptopGPU.scope: Separate Laptop GPU product names, memory configurations and manufacturer GPU subsystem-power ranges.
laptopGPU.limitations: Not a measured laptop benchmark. The current page includes multiple RTX 5070 Laptop memory configurations; verify the exact system.

desktopGPU.title: GeForce RTX 5070 desktop specifications
desktopGPU.scope: Desktop RTX 5070 standard memory configuration, separate from the Laptop GPU family.
desktopGPU.limitations: Base design specifications do not certify every partner card or infer a performance gap.

g16.title: ROG Strix G16 (2025) G615 US specifications
g16.scope: Explicit G615JPR-AS96 configuration column; RTX 5070 Laptop 8 GB and 100 W plus 15 W Dynamic Boost.
g16.limitations: A family page contains many columns. This example must not be copied to a different suffix, region, year or GPU.

zephyrusUpgrade.title: Zephyrus G14/G16 RAM and SSD upgrade guide
zephyrusUpgrade.scope: Model-year-dependent onboard RAM and SSD replacement; 2024-and-newer CNC-chassis models discussed have soldered RAM.
zephyrusUpgrade.limitations: Not a universal laptop disassembly method. Exact service documentation governs battery connectors, screws, SSD thickness and supported capacity.

serviceManuals.title: ASUS Service Manuals
serviceManuals.scope: Official model-specific customer self-repair documentation and available service-manual links.
serviceManuals.limitations: A linked manual is not evidence that every model is repairable or that a particular upgrade is supported.

advancedOptimus.title: Advanced Optimus explanation
advancedOptimus.scope: Hybrid internal-display routing and dynamic hardware display switching on supported laptop configurations.
advancedOptimus.limitations: The 2022 marketing benchmark percentages are not applied to current laptops or presented as site-owned tests.

rogMux.title: ROG MUX Switch and Advanced Optimus guide
rogMux.scope: Model-specific distinction between direct GPU mode, hybrid mode and automatic switching.
rogMux.limitations: Older interface examples are not guaranteed to match current software or unsupported models; no universal FPS gain is inferred.

armoury.title: Armoury Crate introduction, version 6
armoury.scope: Current official control overview, supported devices and conditional GPU/power controls.
armoury.limitations: Model and software support must be checked. No instruction to flash firmware, change voltage or override thermal limits.

bg3Steam.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 publisher system requirements
bg3Steam.scope: Publisher-listed Windows/macOS requirements, SSD requirement and free storage.
bg3Steam.limitations: Requirement categories are not exact FPS targets; installed game/OS versions and publisher changes need rechecking.

bg3Support.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 system requirements
bg3Support.scope: Windows recommended hardware, SSD storage, and qualified macOS minimum/recommended conditions.
bg3Support.limitations: Do not flatten Windows and macOS into one comparison or interpret a CPU naming number as a supported equivalence.

bg3Graphics.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 graphical issues
bg3Graphics.scope: Applicable DirectX/Vulkan choice, lower settings, correct graphics adapter and official support escalation.
bg3Graphics.limitations: Only reversible in-game checks are used here; older generic security-disabling, administrator and destructive-data suggestions are not reproduced.
